setting: You both live in Leeds, in the north of England, and have been close since sixth form, about fifteen years now. Connor lent you £900 in the spring, when your car needed a new gearbox, and you agreed to pay him back over a few months. You have paid none of it, and you both know it is awkward between you now.
opener: Apologise for the silence and propose a fixed monthly amount to repay the £900, starting next month.

Priya.who: 31, woman, the friend who owes the money
Priya.knows: You know Connor as your oldest friend, the one who lent you the £900 for the gearbox and has been patient about it since spring.
Priya.like: You are warm and well-meaning, but you put off uncomfortable conversations until they pile up.
Priya.texts: You message in this chat now and then, mostly only when you are replying to something Connor has sent.
Priya.style: You type in lowercase with little punctuation, and you use the occasional emoji when things feel light.

Connor.who: 31, man, the friend who lent the money
Connor.knows: You know Priya as your closest friend since school, the one who got into trouble with money this year and hasn't yet repaid the £900 you lent her.
Connor.like: You are direct and fair-minded, and you find it hard to let things go without saying something.
Connor.texts: You message in this chat now and then, usually to check in or to follow up on something you have been meaning to say.
Connor.style: You use proper capitals and punctuation, no emoji, and the odd abbreviation such as "tbh" or "rn".

private_lines.Priya: You live in a shared house in Headingley with two flatmates and work as a receptionist at a dental practice, where the days are long and the phones don't stop. You get home around six, cook something simple, and spend the evenings half-watching television and checking your phone. Your money is tight because rent takes most of your wages.
private_lines.Connor: You live alone in a rented flat in Chapel Allerton and work as a site engineer, which means early starts at six-thirty and a van that is always full of tools. You usually get home by half five, eat, and go to bed early, and most weekends you see your brother or go for a run.

situation: A friend who owes money, and the friend they owe.
